findings.claim: The Slack-origin to canonical Discord-destination delivery behavior was not implemented.
findings.observed: The supplied task-scoped diff contains documentation, changelog, and contract-fixture changes but no final-adapter, KM client, plugin runtime, configuration, or focused behavioral test implementation for structured Discord delivery; the task checkpoint explicitly records implementation as blocked because the accepted contract remains string-based.
findings.rationale: Without structured destination handling and destination-selected Discord dispatch, a Slack-origin ready item cannot make the required exact Discord account/channel/thread send.
findings.required: Implement the accepted structured Discord destination lifecycle and the Slack-origin to Discord dispatch behavior, including exact target fencing and one configured send.

findings.claim: The caller-required RED/GREEN TDD proof is absent.
findings.observed: The run manifest declares tddRequired true, no TDD proof is supplied, and the follow-up checkpoint leaves genuine RED capture and GREEN verification incomplete.
findings.rationale: The mandatory TDD process cannot be established from the supplied review material.
findings.required: Supply valid task-scoped genuine RED and GREEN proof for the required implementation.
